title: confiture migrate validate --idempotent --format json
description: Idempotency validation report — scans every migration file (SQL + Python) for non-idempotent SQL patterns. Empty-input shape (no migration files found) replaces the violations report with a `message` field.

status.description: `issues_found` when any violation exists (exit 1 for blocking ones); `unverified` when no violation exists but at least one execute/execute_file call could not be statically read (exit 0, or 1 under --fail-on-unanalyzable); `ok` only when every call was read and nothing was found. Added `unverified` in 0.46.0 (#213).

has_blocking_violations.description: True when any violation has severity=error. info-only findings keep this false unless --strict-cor is passed.

backend.description: Which detection backend ran. `ast` = pglast-backed AST (preferred); `regex` = fallback when pglast is missing or CONFITURE_IDEMPOTENCY_FORCE_REGEX=1 is set.

fail_on_unanalyzable.description: Whether --fail-on-unanalyzable was passed. With it, status 'unverified' exits 1; without it, 0. The status never depends on the flag — only the exit code does. Added in 0.46.0 (#213).

analysis_complete.description: True when every execute/execute_file call the run was asked about was actually read. False whenever `warnings` is non-empty. Added in 0.46.0 (#213).

unanalyzed_count.description: Number of execute/execute_file *calls* (not statements) whose SQL was never read — equals len(warnings). Added in 0.46.0 (#213).

parser.description: What parsed the SQL behind this payload (0.50.0): the installed pglast release and the PostgreSQL grammar major it embeds.

oneOf.description: Empty-input shape: no migration files found, or a git scope that selected none. Vacuously complete.
